Our Story

Crafting exceptional coffee experiences since 2010

Our Journey

2021 - The Beginning

Last Summer Like every great story, ours began with a dream. Last Summer Coffee was founded out of a deep passion for coffee — just like the heroes of Son Yaz, we stepped onto a path that would change everything.

2024 - First Location

When our first café opened, people didn't just come for coffee — they came to share their feelings, memories, and stories. Just like Akgün taking his first steps toward a new life, we opened the door to a new beginning.

2025- Expansion

Despite challenges, we expanded our operations and introduced online ordering. Our commitment to quality and sustainability earned us recognition in the industry.

2026 - Today

Today, Brûlé Coffee serves thousands of customers daily with our carefully sourced beans, expertly crafted beverages, and warm hospitality. We're just getting started!

Meet Our Team

Emma Davis

Strong, determined, and unshakeable — just like Yağmur. Emma keeps everything in perfect order and makes sure every customer leaves with a smile.

James Wilson

Customer Experience

Like the warm heart of Son Yaz, Canan believes that every person who walks through our door deserves to feel seen, welcome, and valued. For her, it's never just coffee — it's a human connection.
